create_catch_environment: create a Catch RL environment with configurable width, height, discount, and seed
reset_catch_environment: reset the Catch environment to initialize ball and paddle positions randomly
step_catch_environment: step the Catch environment with an action and return observation, reward, discount, and step type
get_observation_catch: get the flattened observation array representing ball and paddle positions on the board
get_observation_spec_catch: get the observation specification dict describing info_state, legal_actions, and current_player shapes
